# Tempo

> Tempo is online booking software for service businesses such as salons, clinics, studios, classes, consultants and mobile services. Customers book from a page you share. You run the calendar, team and payments in one place.

## Facts
- Price: $15 CAD per month (plus applicable taxes where required). Includes 1 location and 5 staff.
- Extra location: +$15 CAD per month. Extra staff pack (5 more staff): +$5 CAD per month.
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required.
- Features: online booking page, group classes with waitlist, deposits with Stripe, email and text reminders, multiple locations, website contact form and booking pop-up.
- Tempo is a scheduling tool, not a medical records system.
